import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_42/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_42/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_42/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_42/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_42/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables
df_union = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY 'missing_count' and aggregate sum for other columns
df_grouped = df_union.groupby('missing_count', as_index=False).agg({
    'state': 'sum',
    'latitude': 'sum',
    'longitude': 'sum'
})

# Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and types are integer
df_grouped = df_grouped.astype({
    'missing_count': 'int64',
    'state': 'int64',
    'latitude': 'int64',
    'longitude': 'int64'
})

# Write the final output
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_42/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
